title: Senior DevOps / SRE engineer (Kubernetes / Terraform / AWS)
description: An 8-year DevOps/SRE with a Kubernetes/Terraform/AWS/Prometheus stack evaluated against 8 postings: one strong staff-SRE match with multi-cloud gaps, one semantically equivalent infrastructure role phrased entirely in generic vocabulary, one marginal cloud-security role, and five cross-domain distractors.
rationale: j2 describes exactly the resume's core competency — running containerized workloads with infrastructure-as-code and an observability stack — using deliberately generic vocabulary ('container orchestration platform', 'declarative infrastructure-as-code tooling', 'a major public cloud provider', 'observability stacks') that shares zero tokens with the resume's brand-name skills (Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, Prometheus, Grafana), so TF-IDF has no signal while embeddings should recognize the match. Gap target j1 overlaps heavily (Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, Prometheus, Grafana, Helm all demanded or mentioned) while requiring GCP and Istio, which the resume clearly lacks (high), Go, which the resume touches only through one side project (medium), and HashiCorp Vault as a preferred item (low) — justifying grade 3 with unambiguous annotated gaps. j3 (cloud security) probes the graded boundary: genuine AWS/Terraform overlap but a different job family, hence grade 1. The remaining five jobs are cross-domain distractors with no meaningful overlap. Senior tag: 8+ years of experience and staff-level scope in the target job.

jobs.raw_text:
Staff Site Reliability Engineer — Meridian Pay (Remote, US)

Meridian Pay processes card payments for 4,000 mid-market merchants. We are hiring a Staff SRE to own reliability of the payment platform as we expand from AWS into GCP.

What you will do:
- Own reliability of payment services running on Kubernetes across AWS and GCP
- Extend our Terraform modules and Helm charts for multi-region infrastructure
- Evolve SLO monitoring and alerting built on Prometheus and Grafana
- Build internal Kubernetes operators in Go to automate failover and capacity management

Requirements: Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, GCP, and Istio in production. 7+ years in SRE, DevOps, or infrastructure roles; 3+ years operating production Kubernetes at scale. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience; CKA certification is a plus.

Nice to have: HashiCorp Vault, Kafka operations, PCI-DSS experience.

jobs.raw_text:
Infrastructure Engineer — Corvana (Hybrid, Chicago IL)

Corvana builds logistics software for regional freight carriers. Our platform team keeps a deliberately boring stack humming, and we describe what we need in terms of fundamentals rather than brand names.

You will operate and scale a fleet of containerized services across multiple regions, define every environment with declarative infrastructure-as-code reviewed through pull requests, and tune metrics collection, alerting rules, and dashboards so on-call engineers see problems before customers do.

We look for: production experience with a container orchestration platform, declarative infrastructure-as-code tooling, a major public cloud provider, and observability stacks covering metrics, alerting, and dashboards. 6+ years running production infrastructure. Bonus: a general-purpose scripting language for automation and progressive delivery pipelines.

Bastionware helps fintech companies pass audits without slowing engineering down. We are hiring a Cloud Security Engineer to harden customer cloud environments.

You will review AWS accounts against CIS benchmarks, codify security guardrails as service control policies with Terraform, triage findings surfaced by our SIEM, and run tabletop incident exercises with customer teams.

Requirements: AWS security services (IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub), SIEM tooling (Splunk or Sumo Logic), threat modeling, and working knowledge of SOC 2 and PCI-DSS frameworks. 4+ years in cloud security or security engineering. Bonus: Terraform, penetration testing experience.
